text:
alice.platform: Hey folks — trying to pull the APAC Service Overview for model-inference-prod and got a 403 in Grafana. Need p95/p99 latency and the latest deploy trace for a quick RCA. Anyone have the shortlink or can check my permissions? cc @darren-ml

darren-ml: I can grab the trace, but looks like a permissions issue. Which org/role are you hitting this from? are you on the SSO account or the service account?

alice.platform: I'm on my @redwood SSO, role = Platform-Eng (standard). I could access this a week ago. Error shows: `You do not have permission to view this dashboard (403)`

ben.sre: grafana-bot just posted an alert yesterday about a role-cfg rollout. lemme check ACLs. If you paste the url i can try to open as you.

alice.platform: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd1234/apac-service-overview?orgId=5

ben.sre: opening... yep getting 403 when impersonating your role. Looks like the dashboard's folder is restricted to group:observability-leads. I'll add a shortlink in the observability space and ping infra.

irina-ops: quick workaround: you can use the public shortlink `/d-s/apac-service` (read-only) until we fix ACLs. shortlink: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d-s/apac-service

alice.platform: thanks! that opens. do you know if the model-health panel for `m-infer-v2` is on that dashboard or a different one?

darren-ml: model health is on a nested panel under the same dashboard but sometimes we split it into `model-health-apac` for heavy tags. can you confirm which model id? is it `m-infer-v2` or `m-infer-v2-quant`?

alice.platform: m-infer-v2 (non-quant). Looking for recent regressions post 2026-03-15 deploy.

ben.sre: ok pulled p95/p99 for last 24h: p95=143ms, p99=520ms for m-infer-v2 in apac cluster. I also grabbed trace id `trace-20260315-7a9f`. darren, can you correlate?

darren-ml: yep correlating now. the trace shows a spike at 2026-03-15T03:21Z tied to a config change in shard-routing. adding note: likely fallback to CPU path for some pods.

irina-ops: ACL fix: adding alice.platform to `observability-readers` group and adding the dashboard view permission for orgId=5. give it 2 minutes and refresh.

alice.platform: refreshed — can view full dashboard now. confirmed model-health tile present and trace link works. thanks all :thumbsup:

ben.sre: left a short comment on the dashboard and created infra ticket INFRA-4721 to make the shortlink permanent and review folder ACLs. tagging this thread in the ticket.

alice.platform: perfect. can someone add the trace id and p99 number to the ticket? i want it in the RCA notes.

darren-ml: will do, adding `trace-20260315-7a9f` and p99=520ms to INFRA-4721.

grafana-bot: Note: shortlink `d-s/apac-service` was accessed by alice.platform at 2026-03-17T14:07:10Z

alice.platform: thanks everyone. closing this thread — will follow up in the ticket for any further action.
